activeSlice.scope: Make Brand Brain retain source-grounded editorial publisher context during live onboarding; prove it with a disposable public-brand validation before Hunter runs.
successCriteria: A news or editorial website cannot persist conflicting automotive or food core Brand DNA when its source evidence identifies it as a publisher.
The deployed production route is identified before any production re-test.
No Hunter run starts until the real Brand DNA is truthful and required owner confirmations are complete.
